text: If you partner has submitted all the documents for the partner visa application online, then PIBA is not allowed to deport you before they decide your application. (And you don't need to keep written proof of the PIBA appointment with you at all times). But you should still do what you can to make sure you stay on a valid visa - if your branch allows walk-ins (most do) you should both arrive early in the morning on any weekday except Wednesday and ask for an extension to your B2 visa in the meantime (you will have to pay). I would recommend doing this ASAP, especially with the holidays coming up.
